name: insecure-http-postinstall-fetch-exec
note: A supply-chain weakness pattern: a postinstall hook fetches a native binary over PLAINTEXT HTTP from a hardcoded bare IP, then extracts + chmod 0755 + executes it, with no integrity pinning (any checksum comes from the same server; verification is skipped when absent). A network MITM or a compromised/repointed dist-server achieves RCE on every installing machine. pkgxray correctly blocks on network-exfil-or-loader (remote fetch reaching an exec sink) + install-hook. Modeled generically (documentation IP 203.0.113.10, RFC 5737) to capture the pattern without naming any specific package.
